title: ClusterFusion: Hybrid Clustering with Embedding Guidance and LLM Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2512.04350v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Text clustering is a fundamental task in natural language processing, yet traditional clustering algorithms with pre-trained embeddings often struggle in domain-specific contexts without costly fine-tuning. Large language models (LLMs) provide strong contextual reasoning, yet prior work mainly uses them as auxiliary modules to refine embeddings or adjust cluster boundaries. We propose ClusterFusion, a hybrid framework that instead treats the LLM as the clustering core, guided by lightweight embedding methods. The framework proceeds in three stages: embedding-guided subset partition, LLM-driven topic summarization, and LLM-based topic assignment. translated_title: ClusterFusion：融合嵌入引导与大语言模型自适应的混合聚类
translated_abstract: 文本聚类是自然语言处理中的一项基础任务，然而使用预训练嵌入的传统聚类算法在特定领域场景中，若不进行代价高昂的微调往往表现不佳。大语言模型（LLM）提供了强大的上下文推理能力，但以往的研究主要将其作为辅助模块来优化嵌入或调整聚类边界。我们提出了ClusterFusion，这是一种混合框架，它转而将大语言模型视为聚类的核心，并由轻量级嵌入方法加以引导。该框架分为三个阶段进行：嵌入引导的子集划分、大语言模型驱动的主题总结，以及基于大语言模型的主题分配。这一设计使得领域能够直接融入领域知识和用户偏好，充分发挥大语言模型的上下文自适应能力。在三个公开基准数据集和两个新的领域特定数据集上的实验表明，ClusterFusion不仅实现了最先进的性能
tldr: ClusterFusion提出了一种以大语言模型为聚类核心、由轻量级嵌入方法引导的三阶段混合聚类框架（嵌入引导子集划分、LLM主题总结与LLM主题分配），无需昂贵微调即可融入领域知识，并在多个公开基准和领域数据集上取得最先进的文本聚类性能。
en_tdlr: ClusterFusion is a hybrid clustering framework that treats the LLM as the clustering core guided by lightweight embeddings through three stages—embedding-guided subset partition, LLM-driven topic summarization, and LLM-based topic assignment—achieving state-of-the-art text clustering performance while directly incorporating domain knowledge without costly fine-tuning.
